topics.label: Introduction to the complement lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and context for the lecture on complement.

topics.label: Fundamentals and central organization of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts, nomenclature rules, and the central role of component C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three upstream pathways that drive complement activation and converge on the C3 convertase threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the primary effector mechanisms through which activated complement eliminates pathogens and promotes inflammation.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how regulatory proteins protect host cells from unintended complement-mediated damage.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the distinct clinical manifestations and disease outcomes caused by deficiencies across the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the evolutionary strategies and mechanisms used by pathogens to evade complement immunity.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks and a preview of the upcoming session on the adaptive immune system.
